main_text.p: loquamur, nec sint inter nos dissidia, simusq; integri set aptati in eadem mente, et in eadem sententia, &c. Sed multum vereor, quae nostra peccata sunt, ne hac aetate simus id impetraturi. PAN. Nolo ut colloquendo ulterius pergamus. Nam dum sermones cedimus, elapsum est permultum temporis, & alia mihi agenda sunt. ORO. Per me tibi licet quocunque voleris abire. Precor tibi meliorem mentem & sanam doctrinam. PAN. Ego vero quid tibi precer ignoro. Id tantum peto ut de re sacramentaria cum Luthero facias, & de nostra veneranda Vbiquitate, rectius post hac & sentias & loquaris.

page.notes: The left-hand strip is a cut-off fragment of the facing page (the outer edge of its text), too fragmentary to transcribe reliably; it is not transcribed. Underlined passage in the main text is printed in italic with underlining as shown. Some words in the body are doubtful due to scan quality: "quocunque" and "voleris" read as printed as well as possible.
